subject.title: refactor: remove stale internal deprecated compatibility

question: After the branch is rebased and live runtime proof is added, do owners accept the remaining deprecated-symbol removals as strictly internal compatibility cleanup?
rationale: The sweep crosses several runtime subsystems and already required two SDK restorations, so automated review cannot safely make the final compatibility-boundary judgment.

options.title: Rebase and approve the audited subset
options.body: Resolve current-main conflicts, refresh the compatibility audit and live proof, then merge only the removals still proven unreachable from shipped contracts.

options.title: Narrow the cleanup further
options.body: Retain any ambiguous exported alias and land only symbols with direct zero-caller and package-surface proof.

recommendation.title: Rebase and approve the audited subset
recommendation.body: Resolve current-main conflicts, refresh the compatibility audit and live proof, then merge only the removals still proven unreachable from shipped contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: This person sponsored the canonical cleanup and has adjacent merged core-runtime history relevant to the final compatibility judgment.
